          Need Help Deciding?

          Help Me Choose

          Top moi RBC Visa Questions

          You can earn and redeem points at all participating Metro, Jean Coutu, Super C, Brunet and Premiere Moisson stores in Quebec.

          In Ontario and New Brunswick, the Moi program is offered at Jean Coutu stores.

          You can use your moi RBC Visa credit card anywhere Visa is accepted, including internationally. No matter where you make your purchase, you’ll earn Moi points for every dollar you spend on purchases.

          You earn 2X points when you use your moi RBC Visa credit card to pay for dining, gas, or EV charging purchases.

          You also earn 2X points when you pay for eligible purchases with your moi RBC Visa credit card and swipe your Moi card at participating stores.

          No. You only need to swipe your Moi card when you shop at Moi banners, including participating Metro, Première Moisson and Brunet stores in Quebec, and Jean Coutu stores in Quebec, Ontario and New Brunswick. You will then earn 2X points on qualifying purchases when you pay with your moi RBC Visa credit card at these locations.

          You do not need to swipe your Moi card to collect points anywhere else, including to earn 2X points on dining, gas, or EV charging purchases.

          You can redeem points earned for purchases at the checkouts in participating Metro, Jean Coutu, Super C, Brunet and Premiere Moisson stores.

          To view redemption options and how to redeem, please visit this site.

          Your points are added to your Moi account monthly. For more information please visit this site.

          You will be eligible to receive 3,000 welcome Moi points upon your first purchase (“Welcome Points”). The Welcome Points will appear on your monthly credit card statement and your Moi account up to six (6) weeks after your first purchase, provided your moi RBC Visa credit card account (“Credit Card Account”) remains open and in good standing at that time, “good standing” meaning that your Credit Card Account must not be past due for more than two (2) consecutive Credit Card Account statement periods, closed, charged off or in credit revoked status at that time.

          To receive 2,000 bonus Moi points (“Bonus Points”), (i) a total of $500 or more in qualifying net purchases and/or pre-authorized bill payment transactions (“Qualifying Transactions”) must be posted to your Credit Card Account within the first 3 months from your Credit Card Account opening date, and (ii) your Credit Card Account must remain open and in good standing at the time the Bonus Points are awarded to your Credit Card Account and your Moi account, approximately six (6) weeks after the date you reach $500 in Qualifying Transactions. Qualifying Transactions exclude cash advances (including balance transfers, cash-like transactions and bill payments that are not pre-authorized charges that you set up with a merchant), interest charges and fees, and credits for returns and adjustments will reduce the amount of your Qualifying Transactions.
